webscript.description:
Exports one or more nodes within an ACP file and streams the archive back to the client.
The body of the post should be in the form
{
   "nodeRefs" : array of nodeRefs to export,
   "items" : { (optional) displayed search-result table embedded as a timestamped AGS_Search_Results_<timestamp>.csv inside the archive
      "headers" : array of column labels,
      "rows" : array of rows, each an array of cell values
   }
}
